'''Twelve''', designated '''CT-12/12-0068''', was one of the numerous [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] created from [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Guide" /> Like Fett, Twelve was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Guide" /><ref name="DB Clone troopers" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Twelve served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Clone major/Legends|clone trooper major]] and led [[Hawkbat Battalion]], a unit of 576 [[Troop/Legends|troops]].<ref name="Guide" /> Formed during the buildup to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|27|Hawkbat Battalion}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Hawkbat [[Battalion/Legends|Battalion]] was one of the four battalions that made up the [[101st Regiment]], which fell under the [[7th Legion]], [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]], [[Second Army|2nd Sector Army]], and [[Systems Army Alpha]].<ref name="Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Twelve was first mentioned in ''[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]'', an article written by [[Karen Traviss]] and [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 84|''Star Wars Insider'' 84]] in [[September]] of [[2005]].<ref name="Guide" /> In [[2008]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] was mentioned in Hawkbat Battalion's entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" />
